name: agent-roster-narrow-owners
body: `solution.component.distributed-agent-install` owns the distributed-agent embed/install/upgrade surface in the binary and the help-text roster; `solution.component.distributed-reviewer-prompt` owns the reviewer prompt file; `solution.component.agent-roster-docs` owns the roster docs. `solution.component.distributed-agent-install` is distinct from `solution.component.agent-fs-install-registry`, which owns the fs-tools surface; `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` and `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance` both share `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`.
